samples.text: In the beginning, everything was dark and empty. Then God spoke.
samples.quote: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

samples.text: Long ago, people had filled the earth with wrong things. But Noah loved God and walked with Him.

longVerses.verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth

samples.text: God led His people to a tall mountain called Sinai. Thunder rumbled, and a thick cloud covered the top of the mountain.
Hannah prayed for a baby, and God gave her a son named Samuel. When he was older, Samuel lived at God's house to help Eli the priest.

longVerses.verse: The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost

samples.text: Jacob loved his son Joseph very much, and he made him a beautiful, colorful robe. Joseph's brothers were jealous.
A cruel king of Egypt, called Pharaoh, gave an order that the baby boys of God's people must be thrown into the river.

longVerses.verse: When I am afraid I put my trust in you
